metadata.experiment_name: 微型随机 SVD 离线对照实验
metadata.paired_randomness: For each seed, draw an 80x24 Omega and take its first k+p columns. All q values share Omega.
metadata.execution_order: Within each dataset, baseline measured first; randomized settings shuffled for each seed using RNG seed 20261113.
metadata.timing_scope: Only algorithm and rank-k reconstruction; randomized method includes RNG initialization, full shared-width Gaussian draw and prefix selection. Excludes dataset construction, warmups, reconstruction-error calculation and JSON serialization.
limitations: Three synthetic matrices at one small size, one target rank and one data seed; results do not establish general superiority or a new algorithm.
20 sampling seeds measure randomness on these fixed matrices; they are not 20 independent datasets.
Wall-clock timings are actual local measurements and are sensitive to scheduling and overhead; they are not large-scale speedup claims.
The exact baseline is measured before randomized methods; the warmup and shuffled randomized order reduce, but do not eliminate, timing-order effects.
All randomized settings draw 24 columns for paired comparisons; narrower p values include unused-column sampling overhead.
More p or q entails extra work; observed accuracy improvements do not imply an equal-cost comparison.
Computational checks support these finite experiments; they do not replace a general mathematical proof.
